negative_reviews.author: Giulia F
negative_reviews.text: Food is very good, but it's a real shame that this place has such dirty toilets and a messy entrance. Even the pillows on the seats were stained and were turned upside down to hide the marks...! Despite being fairly new the space already looks so old and run down. My message to the manager: pay more attention to the details and cleaning, then this restaurant will be a great spot. But for now I wouldn't recommend it.
